sloka: निमेष अन्तर मात्रेण निरालंबनम् अंबरम् ।सहसा निपतिष्यामि घनात् विद्युत् इव उत्थिता ॥४-६७-२४॥
transliteration: nimeṣa antara mātreṇa nirālaṁbanam aṁbaram ।sahasā nipatiṣyāmi ghanāt vidyut iva utthitā ॥4-67-24॥

translations.english: 'Only Garuda and Maruta have the capacity to fly like me. No one other than the king of vultures and the Windgod have the speed to fly like me.
